name: HSC J2255+0251

images.wavelength_label: F356W rest-frame optical; host-galaxy starlight after quasar point-source subtraction (z=6.34)

paper.title: Detection of stellar light from quasar host galaxies at redshifts above 6

notes: SHELLQs quasar; one of the first two z>6 quasar hosts with detected starlight (JWST/NIRCam 2D decomposition; host stellar mass ~3.4e10 Msun). Added by batch S (quasar expansion from Ren et al. 2024 intro citations). Coordinates derived from the HSC IAU designation J225538.04+025126.6; SIMBAD refinement pending via coords_todo_batchS. Batch T verified against Ding+2023 Extended Data Table 1: RA 22:55:38.04 Dec +02:51:26.60 and z=6.34 match exactly (NIRSpec [OIII] systemic z=6.333+-0.001); host detected in F356W only (F150W upper limit m_F150W>26.3).
